title: Marked lines and the gaps below them
question: In fixed source-guided LP2 image regions, do apostrophes, quotation marks and digits occur on the lines immediately above unusually wide gaps?
summary: Six marked lines on five selected pages are followed by 108–110-pixel gaps; 28 unmarked lines in the same regions and one control have 73–75-pixel gaps. LP2-35 needs its reviewed apostrophe correction to register the observed mark.

scope.representation: Aligned rows from original 2400×3600 JPEG crops and the archived raw/reviewed text fields in their structured page records.
scope.procedure: Predeclare six source-guided image rectangles; count fully blank horizontal rows between printed lines at three thresholds; align each gap with the raw and reviewed text line above; compare punctuation/digit marks with the following gap.
scope.parameters: Six pages, 34 measured interline gaps, ASCII apostrophe/double-quote/digit markers, wide-gap descriptive cutoff 100 pixels, grayscale cutoffs 100/160/200, five dark pixels per row, merge across at most 14 blank rows.
scope.exclusions: Whole-book mark/gap association, independent sampling, causality, original author screenshot coordinates, typesetting mechanism and binary decryption.

finding: The six marked lines all have 108–110 blank pixels below; 28 unmarked measured lines have 73–75. Raw text detects only five marked wide gaps because its LP2-35 line 4 omits the apostrophe that the image and reviewed text contain.
limitations: Pages and lines were selected from an existing hypothesis, so perfect local alignment is not a population-level test or an independent significance estimate. The upright LP2-35 mark is visually adjudicated in the site's reviewed layer; the original report's image coordinates are unavailable.
next_steps: Freeze bounding boxes for every text line on all source-labeled and comparison pages, review glyphs independently, then test marker/gap alignment without selecting pages or crop limits from the result.

review.reviewer: Fixed original-image projection, independent flat-pixel checker and visual inspection of LP2-35 mark

reproduction.environment: Python 3.12 and Pillow 11.3.0; original-images.zip and structured page records extracted at repository root. Also run check.py and plot.py --check.

visuals.caption: All six selected punctuation/number lines align with the following wide space; this is a source-guided sample.
Original LP2-35 line-four crop; the archived raw text omits this upright mark while the reviewed layer records an apostrophe.
